items.content:
That's how long it's been. I did the arithmetic today for no reason and
then sat with it.

The thing I can't explain to Mara is that I'm not angry. Angry would be
easier — angry implies something ongoing. It's closer to how you'd feel
about a building that used to be somewhere.

summary: Marks fourteen years of estrangement and names the feeling as grief
title: Fourteen years
